final_message:
I added all three views to `notebooks/explore.py`. `marimo check` passes, and the whole notebook runs and exports to HTML without errors.

**What I added**
- **Total shipments per month:** a line chart of shipment counts (rows) per month, January 2023 to December 2024.
- **`q2_dip(by)` helper:** a small function used by both dip views. For each group and year, it compares the second-quarter shipment count with the average of the first and third quarters of that same year. It reports the change in shipments and as a percentage.
- **Second-quarter dip by port** and **by carrier type:** each has a bar chart split by year (drops in red) plus the table underneath.

**What the data shows**
- **The dip is mostly a 2024 thing.** In 2024, Q2 had 115 shipments against 156 in Q1 and 157 in Q3. In 2023 the drop was small (159 against 171 and 164), and that year's Q4 was actually lower at 128. Because of this I split every view by year rather than combining both years.
- **By port, 2024:** three ports account for most of the drop. Fennick fell 81% (4 shipments against an average of 21), Ivelholm 79%, and Brackwater 67%. Most other ports were roughly flat or up.
- **By carrier, 2024:** tanker fell 45% and container 29%, the largest drop in shipments (−26.5). Bulk fell only 11%.

**Choices you may want to change**
- "Shipments" means the number of rows. Switching to TEU or `value_usd` is a one-line change in each view.
- The comparison point is the average of Q1 and Q3 in the same year. That reads more cleanly as a dip than comparing with the full-year average.

I didn't find a live marimo session running, so I edited the file directly; reload it if you have it open. Nothing is committed.

new='''

@app.cell
def monthly(alt, mo, pl, shipments):
    monthly = (
        shipments.group_by(month=pl.col("ship_date").dt.truncate("1mo"))
        .agg(shipments=pl.len())
        .sort("month")
        .collect()
    )
    monthly_chart = (
        alt.Chart(monthly)
        .mark_line(point=True)
        .encode(
            x=alt.X("month:T", title="Month"),
            y=alt.Y("shipments:Q", title="Shipments"),
            tooltip=[alt.Tooltip("month:T", format="%b %Y"), "shipments:Q"],
        )
        .properties(title="Total shipments per month", width="container")
    )
    mo.vstack([mo.md("## Total shipments per month"), monthly_chart])
    return (monthly,)


@app.cell
def q2_dip_helper(pl, shipments):
    def q2_dip(by: str) -> pl.DataFrame:
        """Q2 shipment count vs. the mean of Q1 and Q3 in the same year, per `by` group."""
        counts = (
            shipments.with_columns(
                year=pl.col("ship_date").dt.year(),
                quarter=pl.col("ship_date").dt.quarter(),
            )
            .group_by(by, "year", "quarter")
            .agg(n=pl.len())
            .collect()
            .pivot(on="quarter", index=[by, "year"], values="n", sort_columns=True)
            .fill_null(0)
        )
        return (
            counts.select(
                by,
                "year",
                q2=pl.col("2"),
                baseline=(pl.col("1") + pl.col("3")) / 2,
            )
            .with_columns(change=pl.col("q2") - pl.col("baseline"))
            .with_columns(pct_change=(pl.col("change") / pl.col("baseline")).round(3))
            .sort("year", "pct_change")
        )

    return (q2_dip,)


@app.cell
def dip_by_port(alt, mo, q2_dip):
    dip_by_port = q2_dip("port")
    dip_by_port_chart = (
        alt.Chart(dip_by_port)
        .mark_bar()
        .encode(
            x=alt.X("pct_change:Q", title="Q2 vs. avg(Q1, Q3)", axis=alt.Axis(format="%")),
            y=alt.Y("port:N", sort="x", title=None),
            color=alt.condition("datum.pct_change < 0", alt.value("#c0392b"), alt.value("#7f8c8d")),
            row=alt.Row("year:O", title=None),
            tooltip=["port", "year", "q2", "baseline", "change", alt.Tooltip("pct_change:Q", format=".1%")],
        )
        .properties(title="Second-quarter dip by port")
    )
    mo.vstack([mo.md("## Second-quarter dip by port"), dip_by_port_chart, dip_by_port])
    return (dip_by_port,)

            color=alt.condition("datum.pct_change < 0", alt.value("#c0392b"), alt.value("#7f8c8d")),
            row=alt.Row("year:O", title=None),
            tooltip=["carrier_type", "year", "q2", "baseline", "change", alt.Tooltip("pct_change:Q", format=".1%")],
        )
        .properties(title="Second-quarter dip by carrier type")
    )
    mo.vstack([mo.md("## Second-quarter dip by carrier type"), dip_by_carrier_chart, dip_by_carrier])
    return (dip_by_carrier,)
